and merges them into one global_sanity_report.csv for trend analysis. Features:
 - Aggregates across all experiments and runs
 - Adds experiment + run columns
 - Flags anomalies:
     * Very low detection rate (<80%)
     * High reprojection error (>2px mean)
     * Large jitter (>5 ms)
     * Coverage too small (<5%)
 - Saves global CSV
 - Optionally generates diagnostic plots (global + trend analysis)
